1. Check source and database: `pg_isready -d app_production && find /srv/app/avatars -type f \( -name '*.png' -o -name '*.jpg' \) | wc -l`
2. Build checksum manifest: `python3 scripts/build_avatar_manifest.py --source /srv/app/avatars --output /var/tmp/avatars.tsv`
3. Record migration start: `psql "$DATABASE_URL" -c "INSERT INTO avatar_migration_runs(id,started_at) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(),now());"`
4. Upload avatars to CDN: `aws s3 sync /srv/app/avatars/ s3://cdn-prod-user-avatars/ --checksum --exclude '*' --include '*.png' --include '*.jpg'`
5. Verify uploaded object: `aws s3api head-object --bucket cdn-prod-user-avatars --key 0042/8f2a.jpg --query '[ContentLength,ETag]' --output text`
6. Update first database batch: `psql "$DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f sql/update_avatar_batch_0001.sql`
7. Reconcile migration results: `python3 scripts/check_avatar_migration.py --manifest /var/tmp/avatars.tsv --bucket cdn-prod-user-avatars`
8. Archive local originals: `test ! -e snapshots/avatars-pre-cdn-20250308.tgz && tar -czf snapshots/avatars-pre-cdn-20250308.tgz -C /srv/app avatars && find /srv/app/avatars -type f -delete`
